resources.string: Places a dictation button over Gboard\'s microphone while the keyboard is in English. Everything runs on this phone.
If the STT Button toggle is greyed out: Settings → Apps → STT Button → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Drag the button to move it. Drop it on Hide at the bottom-left to turn it off until you press the button below, or on Reset at the bottom-right to put it back on the microphone.
